entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I find it hard to believe Harajuku[n]is just outside... The silence in[n]here is simply otherworldly...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, I see! That is why religion[n]has historically tended to be a[n]central motif in the art world.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps artists picked up on[n]something out of the norm...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now then, we should give an[n]offering. Is there anything you[n]want to wish for, [fName]?
Good grades.
A hot girlfriend.
Boatloads of money.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Don't you think you should[n]do something about that[n]through your own effort?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: All you need to do is study harder.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is that something that can be[n]done through prayer...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What would you do if your[n]desired match was praying[n]to never end up with you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hrm!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I-I am somewhat... Actually,[n]I would wish for that as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However... considering I call[n]myself an artist, I should[n]subsist solely on art...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Reliance on a god... Hm.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It sounds sublime, yet is in[n]fact quite ordinary; it is[n]sophistry disguised as prayer.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That unbalance... This festering[n]thing that exists in the depths[n]of people's hearts...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... It may not actually[n]be so bad.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That reminds me, [fName]...[n]Even a one-yen offering is said[n]to bring divine favors, yes?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I would offer more for increased[n]monetary luck, but even five yen[n]is tough for me at the moment...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah well. The gods will surely[n]understand the dire situation[n]of my wallet.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You can have this, [fName].

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: After all, what goes around comes[n]around. One must spend money in[n]order to gain money.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Ah, somebody dropped a[n]ten-yen coin on the ground.[n]How lucky.
